bug_locations: dependency_order: node universe construction built nodes only from deps keys, dropping referenced nodes
dependency_order: missing cycle detection (must raise ValueError instead of returning a partial/empty order)
dependency_order: readiness tracking rewritten to an explicit dependents adjacency so each node is enqueued exactly once when its last dependency is satisfied
explanation: Two interacting defects: (1) nodes=set(deps) ignored referenced-only nodes, so a node like 'a' in {'b':['a']} never became a node; it also sat forever in incoming['b'], so 'b' was never emitted and the result was incomplete. The fix unions all dependency values into the node set and builds dependencies/dependents over that full set. (2) There was no cycle check; cyclic or unresolvable inputs silently returned a partial/empty list. After Kahn's loop, any node not emitted means the remaining subgraph has a cycle, so we raise ValueError when len(out) != len(nodes). The min-heap still yields the alphabetical choice among ready nodes, and the dependents map makes each node enter the heap exactly once.
